565.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Establish E2E coverage for **16 DigitalMate cases: 7 in E4 (artifacts and system integration), 7 in E5 (lifecycle and recovery), and 2 in E6 (installation, release, and compliance)**.

Reuse existing workflows, complete deterministic criteria, and collect actual local execution with traceable evidence. #533 retains the original scenarios and historical records. This issue tracks their migration and re-acceptance under the tiered specification; historical passes do not count as stable passes of the current case version.

### Design Ideas

- Criteria are defined in `tests/cases`; workflows, drivers, assertions, and evidence entry points are in `tests/e2e`.
- #585, #586, and #587 retain the original definitions and partial results. Replacement delivery consists of one PR per E tier, linked to this issue, with the cases, execution entry points, actual results, and screenshots.
- Track specification, implementation, execution, stability, PR, and merge status separately by case version. JSON validation, mocks, historical passes, and CI success do not establish current business acceptance.
- Complete each current case once and retain all required assertions. Repeat only after a relevant change or a new failure; report repeated-run stability separately.

### Involved Public APIs

Use the actual App and normal cloud protocol to verify files, attachments, tasks, interactions, and system resources. Fault controls must be restricted to isolated resources owned by the current run. Server success receipts, login state, and assertions must not be fabricated or bypassed.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Coverage includes `tests/e2e/workflow`, file and attachment operations, task recovery, permissions, reminders, first launch, and upgrades. Tier groups share assertion support. This issue does not expand the separate E0–E3 or ST supplementation scope.

### Test Design and Test Plan

E4 checks external file contents and hashes, artifact versions, attachment ownership, permissions, and system resource differences. E5 checks the in-flight state before interruption, actual device controls, task uniqueness, drafts/cards, and terminal state after recovery. E6 checks clean installation, agreement state, package signing/version/release configuration, and retained upgrade data.

| **Total** | **16** | **16** | **13** | | |

Local execution records include partial and failed runs. A complete local pass requires all business criteria and GPT-6 Astra screenshot review. Repeat execution is reserved for failures or changes that require verification. Definitions, framework regressions, and CI success do not add to business completion counts.

Local testing uses the available emulator, installed packages, and test service. Unknown cloud deployment and model versions are recorded as unknown and do not block local business execution. GPT-6 Astra reviews the relevant screenshots and records. Replacement cases are grouped into one PR each for E4, E5, and E6, with manual merging.

Documentation PR: #566 (MERGED).

English criteria update: [#667](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/667) (MERGED); reviewed by GPT-6 Astra.
